responsibility: Provides the rs6000 subtarget configuration for AIX 5.2. The file refines option override behavior, assembler CPU mappings for newer POWER processors, OS CPP builtins, startup and link specs, default processor selections for 32- and 64-bit modes, wchar_t and ptrdiff_t layout, and other AIX 5.2 ABI/runtime properties layered on top of the generic AIX support.
